title: Functions of computer
competency: Explain the four basic functions of a computer.

keywords.def: Putting data into a computer, e.g. by typing, taking a picture or recording audio.
Doing operations on the data that was entered, e.g. adding numbers.
Showing the result of processing to the user, through a monitor, speaker or printer.
Keeping data for later, on a hard drive, flash drive or CD.

en.text: A computer has four basic functions. Input puts data in, by keyboard, camera or microphone. Processing does operations on the data, like adding marks to find an average. Output shows the result on a monitor, speaker or printer. Storage keeps data on a hard drive, flash drive or CD. Like a person: eyes take in, brain thinks, mouth answers, memory remembers.

screens.title: The roster
screens.ask: A teacher types students' marks, the computer finds the average, and the printer prints the roster. Which step is the printing?
screens.after: Printing shows the result to the user: output.

screens.title: Four functions
paras: Input: inserting data, e.g. typing on the keyboard, taking a picture, recording audio.
Processing: operations on the data, e.g. adding two numbers, editing a photo, calculating averages.
Output: displaying the result through a monitor, speaker or printer.
Storage: saving data on a hard drive, flash drive or CD, inside or outside the computer.
